## Hi — I'm Stephen.

I'm a **data scientist and bioinformatician** with a PhD and 15+ years building data, ML, and genomics platforms across academia and industry. My work has spanned translational genomics, biomarker discovery, NGS pipelines, and ML for health — and these days I'm increasingly focused on **agentic AI**: memory, tool-use, and reproducible LLM systems.

I care about open science, reproducibility, and turning messy real-world data into things people can actually use.

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
**Open to work / collaborations.** Senior IC and tech-lead roles in data science / ML / bioinformatics — UK or remote. Get in touch via [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sjnewhouse/) or [email](mailto:stephen.j.newhouse@gmail.com).
:::

### What I work on

- **Agentic AI & LLM systems** — memory architectures, retrieval, evaluation. See [`aa-ma-forge`](https://github.com/snewhouse/aa-ma-forge).
- **Bioinformatics & genomics** — NGS, variant analysis, pipelines, reproducible workflows.
- **ML for health** — predictive modelling, biomarker discovery, biostatistics.
- **Open science** — version control, reproducible research, teaching.
